statement: An explicitly commissioned operator-paced Linux host can execute reserved test files without claiming measured thermal readiness. One required native execution policy selects the mode before observation; operator-paced mode enforces one active file and a five-second rest after closure before the next admission. Sensor-required hosts retain actual configured sensor refusal and may add the same cadence. Missing or malformed policy never selects a mode. The authorized Carina WSL2 host is commissioned and exercised through the normal native owner with unavailable temperatures reported truthfully.

constraints.statement: New user-authorized capability, not a repair receipt for the sealed canonical-native-thermal-pacing original. Preserve that Quest, seal, original controls and original failed index unchanged; explicitly record feature scope/applicability alongside the composed candidate.

Native execution_policy is required and validated by its canonical owner: mode sensor-required or operator-paced, cadence_ms a nonnegative safe integer, max_concurrency a positive safe integer. Operator-paced requires cadence_ms5000 and max_concurrency1. No absent-mode defaults, observation-error mode changes, alternate sensors or fabricated temperatures.

Reserve through existing owners; cadence occurs only after a file closes and before the next file starts. No pause inside a test or benchmark sample. Retain original deadlines, cancellation, all first failures, unrun-file accounting and actual process closure. No automatic retry or reassignment.

Commission only the authorized exact host through existing native owners, retain source/config/boot/policy identities and actual user-systemd/linger outcome. Carina sensor absence remains unmeasured; readiness is admission capacity under explicit policy, not measured thermal safety. Other hosts retain explicit current policy.
